issues.display_title: Issue #15: feat: add context history support for chat and suggest-action
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

The /chat and /suggest-action endpoints previously operated in a purely stateless manner per request without conversational memory:

  1. Stateless Prompting: Follow-up questions (e.g., "what's the next step?", "how do I rename it?") were sent to the LLM without prior conversation turns, leading to disconnected or ambiguous responses.
  2. Retrieval Misses on Follow-ups: Short or context-dependent user follow-ups often failed keyword and BM25 document retrieval because essential entity/subject names were only mentioned in earlier conversation turns.
  3. No Standardized Context History Handling: There was no normalization for conversation history payloads supplied in request.context (such as varying key names like history or messages, or different role naming conventions).

Proposed Solution

Introduce conversation context history support to /chat and /suggest-action:

  • Parse and normalize conversation history from request.context supporting history or messages list formats with common role aliases (human, client, sender, bot, ai, etc.).
  • Inject formatted conversation history into the LLM provider prompts to maintain conversational continuity.
  • Implement a retrieval fallback mechanism using the previous user message from history concatenated with the current message when initial retrieval yields no matching documents.
  • Expand retriever stop words to filter common conversational phrasing and avoid false-positive retrieval scoring.

Design

  • History Normalization & Extraction (app/copilot/history.py):
    • normalize_role(role: Any) -> str: Normalizes diverse role aliases into standard roles (User, Assistant, System).
    • extract_chat_history(context: dict[str, Any] | None, limit: int = 10) -> list[dict[str, str]]: Safely extracts and validates recent turns from history or messages, capped at 10 items.
    • format_chat_history(history: list[dict[str, str]]) -> str: Formats turns into Role: Content blocks.
    • get_last_user_message_from_history(history: list[dict[str, str]]) -> str | None: Locates the most recent User utterance for query expansion.
  • Endpoints (app/api/routes_chat.py & app/api/routes_actions.py):
    • Triggers fallback retrieval ("{last_user_msg} {request.message}") if initial document search returns empty and history is present in context.
    • Passes context=request.context to AnswerComposer.compose().
  • LLM Prompting (app/copilot/answerer.py):
    • Injects formatted conversation history into the prompt when present, instructing the model to maintain conversational continuity while remaining grounded in retrieved evidence.
  • Retriever (app/rag/retriever.py):
    • Expanded _STOP_WORDS set to ignore common conversational and auxiliary words.

Sample Payloads

1. Request with Standard History (context.history)

{
  "message": "lalu bagaimana langkah berikutnya?",
  "context": {
    "history": [
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": "How do I unarchive a tour from Google?"
      },
      {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": "Open the tour list and click unarchive."
      }
    ]
  },
  "provider": "openai"
}

2. Request with Alternative Messages Format & Aliases (context.messages)

{
  "message": "can you guide me through it step by step?",
  "context": {
    "messages": [
      {
        "sender": "human",
        "text": "How do I rename my tour in GoThru?"
      },
      {
        "role": "bot",
        "message": "You can rename your tour directly from GoThru Dashboard."
      }
    ]
  }
}

3. Response Example (POST /chat & POST /suggest-action)

{
  "mode": "answer_only",
  "answer": "1. Open GoThru Dashboard.\n2. Go to **My Tours**.\n3. Locate the tour you want to rename and click **Edit**.\n4. Update the title in the tour settings and save.",
  "knowledge_sources": [
    "actions/how-to-rename-your-tours-in-gothru.md"
  ],
  "action_plan": {
    "mode": "answer_only",
    "suggested_action": null,
    "reason": null,
    "required_params": [],
    "missing_params": [],
    "confirmation_required": false,
    "api_candidate": null,
    "api_candidates": [],
    "planned_steps": [],
    "confirmation_token": null
  },
  "debug": {
    "answer_source": "provider",
    "provider_used": "openai",
    "provider_attempted": true,
    "provider_base_url": null
  }
}

Acceptance Criteria

  • Parse and normalize conversation history from request.context supporting history and messages keys
  • Normalize diverse role naming conventions (user, human, client, assistant, bot, ai)
  • Limit parsed history to the most recent 10 turns to avoid prompt token overflow
  • Fallback retrieval using prior user message when follow-up query yields no documents
  • Include conversation history in the LLM prompt with continuity instructions
  • Unit and integration tests for history parsing, prompt formatting, and chat route fallback
  • All test suites pass

Result

  • Implemented app/copilot/history.py with role normalization, history extraction, formatting, and last user message retrieval.
  • Integrated history extraction and contextual prompting into app/copilot/answerer.py.
  • Added retrieval fallback in POST /chat and POST /suggest-action using prior user query when direct document matches are empty.
  • Expanded stop words in app/rag/retriever.py to optimize keyword matching.
  • Added comprehensive unit and integration tests in tests/copilot/test_history.py, tests/copilot/test_answerer.py, and tests/api/test_chat_routes.py.
  • Fixed flaky tampered token test in tests/executor/test_confirmer.py.
  • Merged via PR #16.

issues.display_title: Issue #17: feat: migrate LLM providers and answer composer to LangChain
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

The current LLM provider layer and answer composition in GoThru RAG Copilot have several architectural limitations:

  1. Custom Model Wrappers: OpenAIProvider and GeminiProvider maintain independent API clients and manual parameter mapping in app/providers/, increasing boilerplate whenever new model providers or versions are introduced.
  2. Fragile String Concatenation in Prompting: AnswerComposer in app/copilot/answerer.py manually constructs prompt strings with string interpolations, making prompt maintenance, role formatting, and guardrails harder to manage consistently.
  3. Lack of Standardized LLM Interface: The system lacks an ecosystem-standard abstraction for model interchangeability and structured streaming or chaining.

Proposed Solution

Migrate the provider layer and answer generation flow to LangChain:

  • Add langchain-core, langchain-openai, and langchain-google-genai dependencies to pyproject.toml.
  • Replace manual provider clients with LangChain's standardized chat model interfaces.
  • Refactor AnswerComposer to use ChatPromptTemplate and LCEL (prompt | model | StrOutputParser()).
  • Preserve existing local fallback behavior (local_fallback) when remote provider calls fail.
  • Maintain sensitive text redaction (redact_sensitive_text) and conversational context continuity from request.context.

Technical Design

  • Dependencies (pyproject.toml): Add langchain-core, langchain-openai, langchain-google-genai.
  • Provider Refactoring (app/providers/): Standardize model instantiation through LangChain chat models.
  • Answer Composer (app/copilot/answerer.py): Construct structured chat prompts using ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages(), pipe via LCEL, retain local fallback.
  • Verification: Ensure all 98 existing unit and integration tests continue to pass without regressions.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Add langchain-core, langchain-openai, and langchain-google-genai to dependencies
  • Migrate app/providers/ to LangChain chat models
  • Refactor AnswerComposer to use ChatPromptTemplate and LCEL
  • Preserve local fallback mechanism on LLM invocation failure
  • Preserve secret redaction and conversation history handling
  • All 98 existing test suites pass

issues.display_title: Issue #18: feat: convert GoThru API actions into LangChain structured tools and agent harness
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

Action planning and API execution dispatching in app/copilot/planner.py currently rely on over 300 lines of custom regex matching, manual keyword overlap scoring, and hardcoded step condition evaluation:

  1. Fragile Action Matching: Adding new GoThru API endpoints or action workflows requires manual regex tuning and intent scoring adjustments.
  2. Scalability Bottleneck: As the API catalog grows, rule-based matching becomes unwieldy and fails to properly handle complex multi-step intentions.
  3. No Standardized Agent Harness: Tool execution cannot easily leverage model function-calling or structured parameter extraction.

Proposed Solution

Migrate the action planning and execution engine to LangChain tool calling:

  • Dynamically convert GoThru endpoints from api-catalog.json and actions.json into LangChain StructuredTool instances with Pydantic argument schemas.
  • Use a LangChain agent harness (create_agent) for intent classification, tool selection, and parameter extraction from the conversation and context.
  • Retain the strict HMAC confirmation security gate (app/executor/confirmer.py) to ensure dangerous state-changing operations require user approval prior to execution.
  • Maintain existing response contract (mode: answer_only, needs_context, confirmation_required, action_available).

Technical Design

  • Tool Generation (app/copilot/tools.py): Construct dynamic StructuredTool definitions from ApiEndpointRecord and ActionContract.
  • Agent Harness (app/copilot/planner.py): Replace regex-based _match_contract and manual parameter extraction with LangChain agent tool-calling loop.
  • Security & Confirmation (app/executor/confirmer.py): Preserve HMAC token signing for confirmed steps before any HTTP call is dispatched.
  • Endpoint Compatibility: Preserve ActionPlan Pydantic model and API responses for /chat, /suggest-action, and /confirm-action.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Generate LangChain StructuredTool instances dynamically from GoThru API catalog
  • Implement LangChain agent harness for intent matching and argument extraction
  • Preserve existing safety modes (answer_only, needs_context, confirmation_required)
  • Maintain HMAC signed confirmation tokens for state-modifying actions
  • Unit and end-to-end integration tests verify tool generation and execution flows

issues.display_title: Issue #19: feat: implement LangChain vector store and hybrid retriever for base knowledge
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

The knowledge retrieval mechanism currently in app/rag/retriever.py uses basic token frequency scoring and stop-word matching:

  1. Keyword-Only Matching: User queries containing synonyms, colloquial phrasing, or differing grammar frequently miss relevant GoThru documentation in base-knowledge/.
  2. No Semantic Search: The system cannot perform dense semantic vector retrieval over the knowledge documents and action workflows.
  3. Limited Re-indexing & Retrieval Modularity: The indexer and retriever are custom in-memory loops that do not leverage proven hybrid retrieval patterns (BM25 + Dense Vector embeddings).

Proposed Solution

Upgrade the RAG indexing and retrieval subsystem to LangChain:

  • Represent GoThru markdown docs and action contracts as LangChain Document objects with standardized metadata.
  • Implement hybrid retrieval combining lexical search (BM25) and dense embeddings via a local, self-hosted vector store.
  • Support dynamic catalog and base knowledge re-indexing via the existing admin reload endpoint without requiring server restarts.
  • Ensure 100% self-hosted operation with zero external third-party vector databases or telemetry dependencies.

Technical Design

  • Document Representation (app/copilot/models.py & app/rag/): Convert KnowledgeDocument to LangChain Document containing chunked body and rich metadata.
  • Hybrid Retrieval (app/rag/retriever.py): Combine BM25Retriever with local/provider embeddings vector store using an ensemble or reciprocal rank fusion strategy.
  • Endpoints Integration (app/api/routes_chat.py & app/api/routes_actions.py): Connect /chat and /suggest-action to the updated hybrid retriever while maintaining conversation history query expansion.
  • Admin Ingestion (app/rag/indexer.py): Ensure persistence and hot-reload capabilities remain intact for uploaded action files.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Wrap knowledge documents into LangChain Document format with metadata
  • Implement self-hosted vector store and hybrid retrieval (BM25 + embeddings)
  • Maintain fallback query expansion when conversation history is present
  • Support hot-reloading through /admin/reload-catalog and action uploads
  • Add unit tests covering hybrid retrieval precision and indexer rebuilds
